An '''Ewok Jedi''' was in activity at some point following the [[Declaration of a New Republic/Legends|founding]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]<ref name="G&ORW" /> in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> While unusual for most [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]], they were born with the ability to access and utilize [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].<ref name="DHBoards">{{DHBoards|subdomain=www|url=boards/viewtopic.php?t=7257&postdays=0&postorder=asc&start=15|thread=Shouldn't there be a Wookiee Jedi?|user=[[Randy Stradley]]|date=2005-05-08|time=14:37}}</ref> The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] once attacked a group of [[Sanyassan/Legends|Sanyassans]] who tried to [[Slavery/Legends|enslave]] a fellow [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]], wielding a [[Color/Legends|blue]]-bladed [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and wearing matching [[Jedi apparel/Legends|Jedi garments]].<ref name="G&ORW" />
